description: Critical production fields contain NULL values. 24 missing values spread across 5 critical columns in 60 data rows (40% of rows affected). Missing values impact quantity (7 rows), product_id (4 rows), revenue_cny (4 rows), yield_rate (6 rows), and line_code (3 rows). These nulls prevent accurate production reporting and revenue calculation.
detection_hints: Profiling module detects via ColumnProfile.null_rate and quality_flags. Missing values in identifier columns (product_id, line_code) and quantitative columns (quantity, revenue_cny) with semantic: identifier and semantic: quantitative respectively. Nulls in yield_rate (semantic: ratio) prevent quality analysis.
